description: PowerMods: the installed mods, the release notes and the update of this kit, in one dialog. A switch turns each kit mod off and on, and it tells you when a third-party mod has a newer version on GitHub.

settings.label: Language
settings.hint: The language of the Kanban, Dock and Git Dash bars. Each layout decides: the lang prop of its blocks.

settings.label: Shortcut of PowerMods
settings.hint: Saved in keys.json. A new key removes the other keys of PowerMods, also the macOS key.
